name: Haydee
title: Morrel Ocean Traders
description: The vice president of the Morrel Ocean Traders, which conducts trade across the entire continent. Cold and aloof, she always keeps her distance from those around her.
introduction:
A girl who reveals nothing about herself except that she is the vice president of Morrel Ocean Traders.

She seems like a cold, sharp perfectionist, yet she surprisingly shows an interest in flowers and trains.

She is very close with Cristelle, the president of Morrel Ocean Traders.

She is searching for information about someone named Morcerf, which led her to NOA, where she accepted the invitation to the Journey.
